public_rationale: This is a hedged, conditional forecast with no deadline: Claude Code will raise coder productivity unless technical debt swallows the gains. It can only be scored if the condition is shown to hold, meaning technical debt did not cancel the gains. No study found by October 2026 measures Claude Code's net effect after technical debt. One causal study of coding agents in general found early speed gains alongside lasting rises in technical-debt indicators, which leaves the condition open. With the condition unknown, the forecast cannot be scored.
limitations: Evidence on coding agents is mostly not specific to Claude Code.
The condition largely overlaps with the outcome it qualifies.
